Hi Anita — thanks for flagging this. We've seen a small number of duplicate advance applies during the late-Aug billing run; sorry for the trouble.

Quick plan proposal:
- We'll validate the double-charge in billing (Olga will lead).
- If it is a duplicate advance, we can either issue a refund to the original payment instrument or create a credit note that applies to your next invoice. We usually default to refunds for customer-requested reversals on advances, but we can do whichever Skyline prefers.
- On the tax side: if TDS was withheld, please send the challan or certificate. Our AP will need that to decide whether we should issue a gross refund and let you claim the TDS, or net the refund by the withheld amount and provide a tax certificate.

Olga / Marissa — can you pick this up? Please confirm what docs we need from Skyline and a timing estimate (I think 5–10 business days after confirmation + docs).

Hi Anita — looping in accounting.

Thanks for the attachments, Vivek. To make this clean from a bookkeeping and tax perspective, we propose the following flow unless Skyline requests otherwise:

1) We will prepare a credit request form and a provisional credit note for the duplicate amount (attached as a draft).
2) For immediate cash-out: we can process a refund to the original bank account; to do so we need the signed credit request form and a copy of the remittance proof showing the duplicate transaction (bank statement or payment confirmation).
3) TDS handling: if TDS was withheld by Skyline (per your note), please provide the TDS challan and the amount withheld. Our India accounting team requires the challan to issue a Form 16A (TDS certificate) if we are to gross-up/refund net of TDS. If you prefer Redwood to refund the gross amount and have Skyline claim the TDS itself, let us know — that typically requires your AP to confirm via email.

Timeline (once we have signed form + TDS evidence if applicable):
- Credit note issuance: 1–2 business days
- Refund processing: 3–7 business days after credit note and bank details are verified

I have attached the credit-request-form and a DocuSign link for signature.

Attachments: credit-request-form_SKY.pdf (pdf)
DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-credit-request

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Billing Manager, Redwood Inference

- Olga will issue a credit note for the duplicate advance today.
- We will process a refund for 70% of the duplicate amount (service portion) back to the original bank account you provided; we will net out the actual TDS if you ask us to (per our earlier note) or refund gross and provide Form 16A after processing. Please confirm whether you want the refund gross or net of the TDS withheld.
- The remaining 30% will be left as an account credit pending reconciliation for any FX/bank fees (this can be refunded on request once final reconciliation is complete).
- Expected timing: credit note issued today (Sep 25), refund initiated within 1–2 business days, funds typically visible within 3–7 business days of initiation. We will email you the remittance confirmation and attach the Form 16A if we issue it.

If Skyline wants us to proceed with a gross refund (you will claim TDS with your tax authority), reply to this thread "refund gross"; otherwise reply "refund net" and we will deduct the TDS shown on your challan from the refund and issue Form 16A.
